subject: Demo follow-up: trial orchestration playbook for SummitLane integration
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@summitlane.com>, Mason Lee <mason.lee@summitlane.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up: SummitLane demo + proposed trial plan

Hi Olivia / Mason —

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and lots of alignment on where Redwood can help with your document ingestion and semantic search workflows. I captured the shortlist below so we have a shared starting point for a short, focused trial.

Goal (trial objective):
- Validate end-to-end ingest + semantic search relevance on 3 sample document sets (contracts, support tickets, integration guides).
- Demonstrate 95th percentile query latency < 300ms for typical user queries and show token cost estimates for steady-state.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
- Precision@5 >= 0.75 on annotated query set (you provide 30 representative queries / expected results)
- End-to-end ingest time for 10k docs < 6 hours in our trial environment
- No PII exfiltration flagged in our scanning for sample data set

Scope & timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): align owners, share sample data, confirm technical contacts.
- Week 1: Redwood provides trial env and ingest scripts; SummitLane runs first ingest with Redwood SE support.
- Week 2: relevance tuning and handoff to SummitLane evaluation team; run acceptance queries and double-check metrics.
- Week 3: wrap, lessons learned, and go/no-go decision.

Suggested owners:
- SummitLane Product / Evaluation lead: Olivia Grant (primary)
- SummitLane Technical contact: Mason Lee (integration + infra)
- Redwood AE: Evelyn Hart (owner)
- Redwood SE: Vivek Kulkarni (technical lead)

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (trial tasks, instrumentation, checklist).

Open questions I have for you:
1) Can you confirm who will provide the annotated query set (30 queries) and by when?
2) Any constraints on sample data location (S3 public bucket vs. shared SFTP)?
3) Are there any procurement or security gates we should be aware of that might impact a 3-week timeline?

If that plan looks reasonable I can schedule a 30-minute kickoff next Tue/Wed for the technical walkthrough and handoff to SEs.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com)

---
Attachment: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (4 pages)
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@summitlane.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mason Lee <mason.lee@summitlane.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: SummitLane demo + proposed trial plan

Thanks Evelyn — really helpful recap. Quick answers and clarifications below.

We can commit to providing the 30-query annotated set; Aaron Park (R&D lead) will own this and can deliver by Sep 10. Aaron: looped here — can you confirm?

Data location: preference is S3 in our dev account (we can provision a read-only role). If that's a problem we can SFTP the sample set.

Security questions: we need evidence of SOC 2 Type II and a brief note on data retention for trial artifacts (how long does Redwood keep logs / cached content). Also would like to know if trial telemetry will show token counts per org.

On timeline: Sep 13 kickoff works for our team for an initial tech sync. If Redwood needs additional runway for SE scheduling, let us know.

Appreciate the concise success metrics — we like the Precision@5 target.

Olivia Grant
Head of Product, SummitLane
olivia@summitlane.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@summitlane.com>, Mason Lee <mason.lee@summitlane.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: SummitLane demo + proposed trial plan

Looping in a couple of quick adjustments from the SE side — thanks for the clear ask, Evelyn.

1) Recommend extending to a 3-week trial (Week 0 alignment + 2 full weeks of SE-supported ingest/tuning) given their annotated set and potential integration work.
2) We'll need an IAM ARN for a read-only S3 role (if SummitLane opts for S3). If SFTP, pls share host + creds via our secure intake form.
3) For the SOC 2 / retention ask: we can provide the SOC 2 summary and our standard trial-data retention policy (30 days post-trial unless a different EULA is agreed). I'll attach a draft SOW that includes SE hours and a proposed escrow for additional integration time if needed.

Attachment: sow-draft.docx (SE hours + deliverables).

Marissa / Evelyn — if you agree I can block the SE calendar for Sep 12-24 and I suggest a kickoff on Sep 13 at 10:00 AM PT.

-Vivek

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@summitlane.com>, Mason Lee <mason.lee@summitlane.com>, Aaron Park <aaron.park@summitlane.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: SummitLane demo + proposed trial plan

Thanks everyone — this is great progress. Confirming updated plan below (short version).

Confirmed plan:
- Trial length: 3 weeks (alignment + 2 weeks SE-supported execution).
- Kickoff: Sep 13, 2027 at 10:00 AM PT — 30 min tech sync and handoff.
- Owners: Olivia (Product), Mason (Infra), Aaron (Annotated queries), Vivek (Redwood SE), Evelyn (AE owner).
- Data path: SummitLane will provision read-only S3 role; Mason to share ARN by Sep 10.
- Security: Vivek will attach SOC 2 summary and retention policy; we retain trial telemetry for 30 days by default.
- Acceptance: run annotated queries and evaluate Precision@5 >= 0.75 and ingest time for 10k docs < 6h.

Next steps for SummitLane:
1) Aaron to confirm annotated queries delivery by Sep 10.
2) Mason to provide S3 ARN by Sep 10 or confirm SFTP details.
3) Olivia to confirm kickoff attendee list for Sep 13.

Resources: demo recording (https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-demo-recording), HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/DL-2027-093).

If that matches your expectation I'll create a calendar invite and share the kickoff agenda + pre-kickoff checklist (sample data checklist, roles, and the query template).

Best —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com)
